summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and extends the ControlCode union with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring caveats. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) using the second item of the control code. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, returns early on legacy Windows), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows only). Not verified: test results and mypy, since execution was prohibited. Checked by reading only.
